name: Codex Mono
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: A writer's terminal: every word in a coding font, a centred title, one slate colour for headings, tinted quotes with a coloured bar and outlined highlights. After Drake by liangjingkanji.

zh.description: 写作者的终端：全文用等宽字体，标题居中，各级标题统一用石板灰，引用带底色和彩色竖条，高亮用描边。参考 liangjingkanji 的 Drake。
